# Problem 1 

## Read and Clean the Data
Read the data, clean the names, and retain line, station name, station latitude / longitude, routes served, entrance type, entry, vending, and ADA compliance. Converting entry variable from character to logical. 
```{r}
subway_df = 
  read_csv("data/NYC_Transit_Subway_Entrance_And_Exit_Data.csv", na = c("", ".", "NA")) |> 
  janitor::clean_names() |> 
  select(line:entry, vending, ada) |> 
  mutate(
    entry = case_match(
      entry, 
      c("YES") ~ TRUE,
      c("NO") ~ FALSE 
    )
  )
```
